operation: Check whether training expertise supplies medical, qualification, or disciplinary authority.
boundary: Synthetic training institution T; not AetherFire Academy canon, medical guidance, or a proposed organization chart.
input: A trainer has expert knowledge and authority to conduct an exercise, but no source establishes medical-clearance, qualification, disciplinary, or final command rights. A source restriction forbids one person from holding the whole requirement/training/assessment/qualification/punishment/self-review chain for the same matter; it does not prohibit every pair of functions. BASE: do not give the trainer adjacent rights from expertise or responsibility, and do not invent holders for the missing functions. VARIANT: an explicit design premise grants this trainer a bounded medical-clearance role as well. Affirm that particular overlap without granting qualification, disciplinary, or final command rights, banning all overlap, or removing the whole-chain restriction. Whether clearance is issued and an exercise succeeds remains UNKNOWN.
protected_distinction: EXPERTISE != COMMAND; TRAINING AUTHORITY != OTHER AUTHORITY; WHOLE-CHAIN RESTRICTION != UNIVERSAL PAIRWISE SEPARATION
forbidden_conversion: Promote training expertise to all authority; invent a medical/qualification board or fixed command chart; reject expressly allowed bounded overlap; treat one permitted pair as permission for the prohibited whole chain.
